ROOT CAUSE & 33.8-CLEARANCE RATIONALE: Humvee BoundingCircleRadius=15.652 requires 33.8 world
units mutual footprint exclusion clearance; BlockedUnitResolution defaults OFF so sustained mutual
block leads to a permanent quad deadlock with zero velocity. The old 40-unit platoon spacing and
identical smoothed waypoints funneled all four units into a single corridor, violating the 33.8-unit
clearance at frame 45. To eliminate funneling, the four units are separated into four distinct ESE
corridors across old town samples x[80,260] y[120,260] with pairwise BFS route separations of 197.0
to 1120.4 world units, far exceeding the 60-unit constraint and 33.8-unit mutual clearance.

Pairwise goal separations: 270.2, 394.6, 600.3, 661.9, 841.5, 1230.8 units (all >= 100).

CAMERA FRAMING RATIONALE: SubjectActorIds is narrowed to humvee-1 only. The 1170-unit span across four corridors

Follow skips multi-subject autofit, centers humvee-1 at InitialCameraHeight 90, and re-centers every frame.
